title: SubhanAllah
urdu: اللہ پاک ہے ہر عیب اور نقص سے۔
english: Glory be to Allah, free from every imperfection.

steps.title: Target Select Karein
steps.detail: Tasbeeh counter mein 33 ya apni marzi ka target select karein.

steps.title: Tawajjah Ke Sath Parhein
steps.detail: Har tap ke sath dil mein makna samajhte hue 'SubhanAllah' parhein aur be-dhyani se bachein.

steps.title: Qudrat Par Ghaur
steps.detail: Aasman, zameen aur apne andar Allah ki kamil paaki aur be-niasi ka tasawwur rakhein.

title: Alhamdulillah
urdu: تمام تعریفیں صرف اللہ کے لیے ہیں۔
english: All praise and thanks belong solely to Allah.

steps.title: Shukar Ki Niyyat Karein
steps.detail: Allah ki zahiri aur batini nematon ka shukar ada karte hue 'Alhamdulillah' parhein.

steps.title: Ginti Mukammal Karein
steps.detail: Mutayyan ginti poori hone par itminan ke sath agle zikr ki taraf barhein.

steps.title: Har Hal Mein Shukar
steps.detail: Asaani ke sath sath aazmaish mein bhi Allah ke behtar faisle par razi rehne ki mashq karein.

title: Astagfirullah
urdu: میں اللہ سے مغفرت مانگتا ہوں۔
english: I seek forgiveness from Allah.

steps.title: Tauba aur Istighfar
steps.detail: Gunaahon, waqt ke ziya aur kotahiyon par nadamat ke sath 'Astagfirullah' parhein.

steps.title: Rozana Mamool Banayein
steps.detail: Din mein mukhtalif auqat mein is ko barhane ki koshish karein taake dil saaf rahe.

steps.title: Gunaah Chhorne Ka Azm
steps.detail: Sirf zaban se istighfar na karein balke un aamalon ko sudharne ka irada bhi karein jin par maafi mang rahe hain.

title: Allahu Akbar
urdu: اللہ سب سے بڑا اور عظیم ہے۔
english: Allah is the Greatest and Most Supreme.

steps.title: Azmat Ka Iqrar Karein
steps.detail: Dil se yeh iqrar karte hue 'Allahu Akbar' parhein ke Allah ki barai har khauf, gham aur dunyawi cheez se upar hai.

steps.title: Namaz Ke Baad Tasbeeh Mukammal Karein
steps.detail: SubhanAllah (33) aur Alhamdulillah (33) ke baad Allahu Akbar (34) parh kar namaz ke baad ki sunnat tasbeeh poori karein.

steps.title: Pareshani Mein Himmat
steps.detail: Jab koi mushkil ya fikr bari nazar aaye to 'Allahu Akbar' dohra kar apne Rab ki sab se bari qudrat ko yaad karein.

title: La ilaha illallah
urdu: اللہ کے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں۔
english: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah.

steps.title: Tawheed Ka Markaz
steps.detail: Har jhooti ummeed, dar aur taqat ki nafi karte hue sirf ek Allah ki ibadat aur qudrat ka iqrar karein.

steps.title: Afzal Zikar Ki Qadr
steps.detail: Hadees ke mutabiq sab se afzal zikar 'La ilaha illallah' hai; ise sukoon aur khuloos ke sath dohrayein.

steps.title: Eeman Ki Tajdeed
steps.detail: Subah shaam ya safar aur aaram ke auqat mein is kalme ke zariye apne eeman ko taza rakhein.

title: Durood Shareef
urdu: اللہ ان پر اور ان کی آل پر رحمت اور سلامتی نازل فرمائے۔
english: May Allah send peace and blessings upon him and his family (the Prophet Muhammad).

steps.title: Muhabbat Aur Adab Ke Sath
steps.detail: Nabi Kareem (S.A.W) aur aap ki Aal ki muhabbat, itaat aur adab ke sath durood parhein.

steps.title: Jumu'ah Aur Rozana Mamool
steps.detail: Jumu'ah ke din aur rozana ke zikar mein durood ka hissa zaroor rakhein.

steps.title: Dua Se Pehle Durood
steps.detail: Apni duaon ke aaghaz aur ikhtitam mein durood shareef shamil karne ki aadat banayein.

title: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
urdu: نیکی کرنے اور گناہ سے بچنے کی طاقت و قوت اللہ ہی کی مدد سے ہے۔
english: There is no power and no strength except through Allah.

steps.title: Kamzori Ka E'tiraf Aur Sahारा
steps.detail: Samjhein ke hamare andar kisi bhalai ya badlav ki haqeeqi taqat sirf Allah ki tawfeeq se aati hai.

steps.title: Jannat Ke Khazanon Mein Se Ek
steps.detail: Is kalme ko jannat ke khazanon mein se ek khazana bataya gaya hai; ise kasrat se parhein.

steps.title: Bhari Kaam Ya Mushkil Mein Zikar
steps.detail: Jab koi barri zimmedari ya mushkil aaye to 'La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah' keh kar Allah se madad lein.

title: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
urdu: اللہ پاک ہے اپنی حمد کے ساتھ۔
english: Glory be to Allah and praise is to Him.

steps.title: Subah Shaam Ya Din Mein 100 Bar
steps.detail: Hadees mein din mein 100 martaba is ke parhne ki khas fazilat aayi hai; target 100 set kar ke parhein.

steps.title: Paaki Aur Tareef Ka Ehtiram
steps.detail: Allah ki har aib se paaki aur us ki tamam nematon par us ki tareef ko yakja kar ke parhein.

steps.title: Zaban Ko Halka Aur Dil Ko Pur-Sakoon Karein
steps.detail: Aasan alfaaz aur gahre maani ke sath is zikar ko safar ya farigh waqt mein zaroor dohrayein.

title: SubhanAllahil Adheem wa bihamdihi
urdu: اللہ پاک ہے جو نہایت عظمت والا ہے، اپنی حمد کے ساتھ۔
english: Glory be to Allah, the Supreme, and praise is to Him.

steps.title: Azmat-e-Ilahi Ka Tasawwur
steps.detail: 'Al-Adheem' ke sath Allah ki be-intiha azmat aur jalal ko dil mein bithate hue parhein.

steps.title: Rahman Ko Mehboob Kalimat
steps.detail: Yeh alfaaz zaban par halke, mizan mein bhari aur Rahman ko nihayat mehboob hain.

steps.title: Waqar Ke Sath Tasbeeh
steps.detail: Jald bazi ke bajaye har lafz ko wazeh aur mo'adab tarike se ada karein.

title: HasbunAllahu wa ni'mal Wakil
urdu: ہمارے لیے اللہ کافی ہے اور وہ بہترین کارساز ہے۔
english: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

steps.title: Kafalat Aur Bharosa
steps.detail: Jab insani wasail kam par jayein ya fikr barh jaye to Allah ko apna kafi aur karsaz maan kar parhein.

steps.title: Khaof Aur Dabao Mein Sukoon
steps.detail: Kisi na-insafi, imtehan ya khauf ke waqt is aayat ke zariye dil ko tawakkul aur itminan dein.

steps.title: Amal Ke Sath Tawakkul
steps.detail: Apni koshish aur durust amal ke sath natija Allah ke supurd karne ki aadat banayein.

title: Dua-e-Yunus (La ilaha illa Anta Subhanaka)
arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
urdu: تیرے سوا کوئی معبود نہیں، تو پاک ہے، بے شک میں ہی ظالموں (اپنی جان پر زیادتی کرنے والوں) میں سے تھا۔
english: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

steps.title: Tawheed Aur Apni Ghalati Ka Iqrar
steps.detail: Allah ki tawheed aur paaki bayan karne ke sath apni kotahi ka sachay dil se iqrar karein.

steps.title: Gham Aur Mushkil Mein Sahारा
steps.detail: Jab kisi gham ya tangi mein hon to is dua ke zariye Allah se nijat aur asaani maangein.

steps.title: Yaqeen Ke Sath Dohrayein
steps.detail: Is dua ko sirf rasm nahi balke dil ki sachai aur tawakkul ke sath parhein.

title: Ya Fattah
urdu: اے تمام بند دروازوں اور مشکلات کو کھولنے والے۔
english: O Opener (of doors, relief, provision, and solutions).

steps.title: Band Raston Ke Liye Dua
steps.detail: Jab kaam, rizq ya kisi faisle mein rukawat nazar aaye to 'Ya Fattah' keh kar Allah se asaani aur khushadgi maangein.

steps.title: Dil Aur Samajh Ki Kushadgi
steps.detail: Sirf dunyawi kaam hi nahi balke ilm, hikmat aur hidayat ke darwaze khulne ki niyyat bhi rakhein.

steps.title: Yaqeen Ke Sath Tasbeeh
steps.detail: Har tap ke sath yeh yaqeen rakhein ke har mushkil ki kunji Allah ke haath mein hai.

title: Ya Razzaq
urdu: اے ہر مخلوق کو بے شمار اور بہترین رزق دینے والے۔
english: O Ever-Providing Sustainer.

steps.title: Halal Aur Barkat Wale Rizq Ki Niyyat
steps.detail: Dil mein halal, paak aur ba-barkat rizq ki niyyat ke sath 'Ya Razzaq' parhein.

steps.title: Tawakkul Aur Mehnat
steps.detail: Apni jaiz koshish aur mehnat ke sath sath rizq ki zimmedari Allah ke supurd karein.

steps.title: Har Naimat Par Shukr
steps.detail: Jo rizq aur sahulat pehle se mil rahi hai us par dil mein shukar ka jazba rakhein.

title: Ya Allah
urdu: اے اللہ (تمام صفاتِ کمال کا جامع اسمِ اعظم)۔
english: O Allah (the Supreme Name encompassing all attributes of perfection).

steps.title: Seedhi Pukar Aur Hazri-e-Qalb
steps.detail: Bina kisi takalluf ke apne Rab ko seedha 'Ya Allah' keh kar pukarein aur dil ko un ki taraf mutawajjah karein.

steps.title: Khamosh Ya Aahista Zikar
steps.detail: Sukoon aur itminan ke sath 'Ya Allah' ka wird karein taake dil ki be-chaini kam ho.

steps.title: Har Haal Mein Rab Ka Sahारा
steps.detail: Khushi, fikr, safar ya aaram har waqt is ism-e-mubarak ke zariye apna rabta mazboot rakhein.

title: Ya Musabbib al-Asbab
urdu: اے تمام اسباب اور وسائل پیدا کرنے والے۔
english: O Causer of all causes and Creator of means.

steps.title: Asbab Ke Khaliq Ko Pehchanein
steps.detail: Yeh samajhte hue parhein ke asbab aur wasail khud-ba-khud kaam nahi karte balke Allah unhein asar deta hai.

steps.title: Ghaib Se Behtareen Wasail Ki Dua
steps.detail: Jab zahiri wasail mehdood hon to Allah se aise asbab aur madad paida karne ki dua karein jo aap ke haq mein behtar hon.

steps.title: Wasile Par Nahi, Allah Par Bharosa
steps.detail: Asbab ko apnayein zaroor, magar asli bharosa aur ummeed 'Musabbib al-Asbab' par rakhein.

title: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
urdu: اے ہمیشہ زندہ اور ہر چیز کو قائم رکھنے والے۔
english: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer of all that exists.

steps.title: Madad Aur Istighasa
steps.detail: Hadees ke mutabiq Nabi Kareem (S.A.W) mushkil waqt mein 'Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum bi-rahmatika astagheeth' ke zariye madad talab farmate.

steps.title: Hidayat Aur Thabat Ki Niyyat
steps.detail: Dil, deen aur kaam mein sabit qadmi aur istiqamat ke liye is zikr ko parhein.

steps.title: Itminan Ke Sath Dohrayein
steps.detail: Har tap ke sath is yaqeen ko taza karein ke poori kainat ka nizam Allah ke qaim rakhne se chal raha hai.

title: Rabbighfir li
urdu: اے میرے رب! مجھے معاف فرما دے۔
english: My Lord, forgive me.
reference: Sunan Abi Dawud & Sunan Ibn Majah

steps.title: Aajizi Ke Sath Maghfirat
steps.detail: Apne Rab ko 'Rabb' (parwarish karne wala) keh kar nihayat aajizi aur inkisari se maghfirat maangein.

steps.title: Aahista Aur Dil Se Parhein
steps.detail: Jald bazi ke bajaye har lafz ko samajh kar aur dil ki tawajjah ke sath dohrayein.

steps.title: Rozana Tauba Ka Mamool
steps.detail: Is ko apni rozana ki aadat mein shamil karein taake dil par zamne wali kotahiyon ki gard dhulti rahe.

title: Durood-e-Kareem
arabic: صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا وَنَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ الْكَرِيمِ وَعَلَى آلِهِ وَصَحْبِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
urdu: اللہ رحمت اور سلامتی نازل فرمائے ہمارے سردار اور نبی محمد کریم پر، اور آپ کی آل اور اصحاب پر۔
english: May Allah send peace and blessings upon our Master and Prophet Muhammad, the Generous, and upon his family and companions.

steps.title: Adab Aur Aqeedat Ke Sath
steps.detail: Nabi Kareem (S.A.W) ki karam nawazi aur shan ko dil mein rakhte hue adab ke sath parhein.

steps.title: Safar Ya Rozana Ke Mamool Mein
steps.detail: Rozana ke zikar ya safar aur kaam ke dauran sukoon ke sath is durood ko dohrayein.

steps.title: Barkat Aur Rahmat Ki Niyyat
steps.detail: Apni zindagi, rizq aur aamal mein barkat aur rahmat ke husool ki niyyat rakhein.

title: Durood-e-Ghousia
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ مَعْدِنِ الْجُودِ وَالْكَرَمِ وَآلِهِ وَبَارِكْ وَسَلِّمْ
urdu: اے اللہ! رحمت نازل فرما ہمارے سردار محمد پر جو جود و کرم کی کان ہیں، اور ان کی آل پر، اور برکت اور سلامتی عطا فرما۔
english: O Allah, send blessings upon our Master Muhammad, the mine of generosity and nobility, and upon his family, and grant blessing and peace.

steps.title: Niyyat Aur Hazri-e-Qalb
steps.detail: Tawajjah aur adab ke sath 'Durood-e-Ghousia' parhne ki niyyat karein.

steps.title: Mutayyan Ginti Mukammal Karein
steps.detail: 100 ya apni marzi ke mutabiq target set kar ke itminan se ginti poori karein.

steps.title: Khair O Barkat Ki Dua
steps.detail: Durood mukammal karne ke baad apne aur ahl-e-khana ke liye khair, asaani aur barkat ki dua karein.

title: Sayyiduna Karim Sallallahu Alayhi Wa Aalihi Wasallam
arabic: سَيِّدُنَا كَرِيمٌ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ وَسَلَّمَ
urdu: ہمارے سردار کریم ہیں، اللہ ان پر اور ان کی آل پر رحمت اور سلامتی نازل فرمائے۔
english: Our Master is Generous; may Allah send peace and blessings upon him and his family.

steps.title: Adab Aur Aqeedat Ke Sath
steps.detail: Nabi Kareem (S.A.W) aur aap ki Aal ki shan aur karam ko dil mein rakhte hue adab ke sath dohrayein.

steps.title: Rozana Ya Farigh Auqat Mein
steps.detail: 100 ya apni marzi ka target select kar ke sukoon aur tawajjah ke sath tasbeeh mukammal karein.

steps.title: Rahmat Aur Barkat Ki Niyyat
steps.detail: Apne aamal, rizq aur zindagi mein rahmat aur barkat ke husool ki niyyat rakhein.
